angle: If the man in The Scream isn't screaming, what scream was Munch shutting out?
logline: Everyone thinks the man is screaming, but he is covering his ears against a scream Munch felt pass through nature at sunset, so he turned an ordinary man into a skull-like face, but the blood-red sky may have been real, therefore when someone wrote that only a madman could paint it, it turned out to be Munch himself.
hooks: Munch pencilled 'only a madman could paint this' onto his own Scream.
The Scream began as a painting of an ordinary man in a hat.

script.text: The man in The Scream isn't screaming: he's covering his ears.
So what scream was Munch shutting out?
script.say: So what scream was Munk shutting out?

script.text: In 1892, his notebook described a sunset walk with two friends.
script.say: In eighteen ninety-two, his notebook described a sunset walk with two friends.

script.text: The sky turned blood red, and he sensed an infinite scream through nature.
So the scream is the landscape: Oslo's fjord, seen from Ekeberg hill.
script.say: So the scream is the landscape: Oslo's fyord, seen from Ay-keh-berg hill.

script.text: But his first painting of it showed a plain man in a hat.
So for The Scream, he stripped the man to a hairless, skull-like face.
It may echo a Peruvian mummy shown at the 1889 Paris World's Fair.
script.say: It may echo a Peruvian mummy shown at the eighteen eighty-nine Paris World's Fair.

script.text: But that blood-red sky may have been real.
Scientists blame ash from Krakatoa's 1883 eruption, or rare mother-of-pearl clouds.
script.say: Scientists blame ash from Krakatoa's eighteen eighty-three eruption, or rare mother-of-pearl clouds.

script.text: But someone pencilled into that sky: Could only have been painted by a madman.
Infrared shows it's Munch's own hand, written after a medical student questioned his sanity.
script.say: Infrared shows it's Munk's own hand, written after a medical student questioned his sanity.

script.text: So the scream he shuts out is nature's, and the madman label was his own.
But that scream is fading: in his 1910 version, the yellow is crumbling to white.
script.say: But that scream is fading: in his nineteen-ten version, the yellow is crumbling to white.

post.caption:
The man in The Scream isn't the one screaming, and the insult pencilled into its sky was written by Munch himself.
What do you think he was hearing?
post.youtube_title: The Scream Isn't Coming From the Man
